gap_notes: CORE cannot be scored. Pluto has no Ptolemy/Lilly elemental quality. Hand Horoscope Symbols Ch.4 1981 is one professional school, not consensus and not later Hand. Do not promote reconstruction/transformation to CORE.

Calc already emits astrology.planet.pluto. The celestial_object schema requires function, themes, positive_expression, shadow, and four natal domains. Object withheld: filling those slots from Hand 1981 alone would make one school look like object SoT.

modern_structural is not a schema source_class. Parked source_class=professional / school=modern_professional like other Hand Ch.4 rows. runtime_semantic_candidate, do_not_compare_with, and classification_gap are not schema fields.

Do not flatten Pluto into generic transformation or give all outer planets the same big-transformation text. Hand sequence (not CORE): Uranus disrupts; Neptune dissolves distinction; Pluto makes the old model unviable and forces reconstruction.

Death-and-resurrection is symbolic, not a literal mortality prediction. Transpersonal power is not an automatic literal external-power event. Decay/corruption/death is Hand's lower register, not the complete meaning.

Decomposition→recombination is more precise than generic transformation. Reconstruction is incomplete without building a new workable everyday reality. Evolutionary Pluto is typically cumulative, not Uranian suddenness.

Helping others through transformation is paired with the ethical shadow: exploiting power gained through another's vulnerability. More precise than generic Pluto = manipulation. Cling-to-disintegrating-structure intensifies crisis.
Hand's psychotic-crisis / medication-suppression example is excluded from this ledger. Historical author remark in an astrology book, not a medically validated causal model, not runtime meaning.

Future engine divider (not activated): Uranus = what must change or be freed; Neptune = where boundaries become less definite; Pluto = what can no longer be kept as it was and must be rebuilt. Still Hand 1981, not CORE.

Greene Outer Planets unread. Planets in Transit unread. Sun/Moon/Mercury Hand Ch.4 remain unextracted. Hand 1981 Para Research is dated contemporary-astrology; views later evolved. Next is corpus gap audit, not another book.
